event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your losartan refill request in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target. Your reported reading of 122/78 and two years on a stable dose suggest routine prescribing review rather than an in-person visit; any prescribing decision is up to the reviewing clinician. If your supply is low or already gone, say so here, and also contact your usual prescriber or pharmacist about continuity options so you don't run out. If you develop chest pain, sudden severe headache, or new weakness or speech difficulty, call 911.
